content.comment_body: Hello, I am wondering if the latest version of [product_name] supports PROFINET or only allows MODBUS TCP/IP and S7 protocol connections.
The Ethernet connection to S7 devices uses TCP/IP with the S7 protocol. This means [product_name] can exchange data with [company_name] devices using PROFINET, but not as a PROFINET I/O device.
Reading the I/O will involve creating a map between the I/O and memory areas.

Due to translation issues, it's unclear: Was that a statement or a question? Could you clarify what you mean by 'mask'? Others might also be confused. It might help if you shared an example or diagram.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are requesting clarity on the network communication features of the latest [product_name] firmware, particularly regarding PROFINET compatibility compared to MODBUS TCP/IP and S7 protocol support. There is uncertainty about whether [product_name] can act as a PROFINET I/O device, and some answers are unclear due to language barriers and vague descriptions. This confusion affects users as they try to understand or select the correct protocol for their setup.
analysis.user_expectations: User expects straightforward information about whether [product_name] version [version_no] provides direct support for PROFINET in addition to MODBUS TCP/IP and S7 connectivity.
